neighbours.label: sentence-initial 'Therefore' or 因此 opening a conclusion (also Hence)
fire: The shop is closed today. Therefore, we will buy it tomorrow.
These fats are stored in the body. Therefore, high doses are unsafe.
He missed the deadline. Therefore, his claim was denied.
价格上涨了。因此，销量下降。
天气很冷。因此，学校放假了。
The data are incomplete; therefore, no conclusion can be drawn.
You understand me. Therefore, let us begin.
Rain fell all week. Hence, the match was cancelled.
quiet: The shop is closed today. Tomorrow, we will buy it.
These fats are stored in the body. Some come from nuts.
He missed the deadline. Later, his claim was reviewed.
价格上涨了。后来，销量下降。
天气很冷。今天，学校放假了。
The data are incomplete; meanwhile, no one is working.
You understand me. Now, let us begin.
Rain fell all week. Finally, the match was played.
